name: Shadow Stalker
tactics: While hunting for prey in the world, a shadow stalker lurks in places where mortals commonly battle. It skulks in the darkness, waiting for living creatures to die so that it can devour their shadows. A creature, whether dead or on the brink of death, turns an unhealthy, pale gray when its shadow is devoured. Only by killing the creature that devoured his or her shadow can the victim regain it.

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Born of Shadows
traits.details: The stalker can make a Stealth check to become hidden when it has concealment instead of needing total concealment.

powers.name: Shadow Stalk
powers.usageDetails: when the stalker uses shadow step

hit.description: necrotic damage, and the stalker shifts into the target’s space and melds with its shadow (save ends). While the stalker is melded with the target’s shadow, it moves when the target moves without provoking opportunity attacks, and it gains a +4 bonus to all defenses and a +5 bonus to attack rolls against the target. When the target saves, the stalker shifts to a square adjacent to the target.

powers.name: Shadow Step
powers.trigger: A living creature within 5 squares of the stalker drops to 0 hit points or fewer.

effect.description: The stalker teleports to a square adjacent to the triggering creature and gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls until the end of its next turn.
